北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京雾气浓，湿度高，出行请注意交通安全哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Heavy fog and high humidity in Beijing, please mind traffic safety when traveling!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪体感适中，风力 4级，出门注意防晒补水哦。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi feels moderate with wind force 4, remember sunscreen and hydration when out.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海体感 35℃，炎热注意防暑，及时补充水分！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai feels like 35℃, it's hot, prevent heatstroke, and rehydrate promptly!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天，湿度 84%，体感 30℃，注意保持干爽哦。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Guangzhou, 84% humidity, feels like 30℃, stay dry and comfortable!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳体感 32℃，湿度高，出门记得防晒和多喝水。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen feels like 32℃ with high humidity, remember sunscreen and plenty of water when out.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州晴朗，气温 32℃，紫外线强，外出别忘防晒！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Sunny in Hangzhou, 32℃, strong UV rays, don't forget sunscreen when outdoors!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴朗但湿度高，体感 32℃，注意防晒补水哦。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Sunny in Nanjing but high humidity, feels like 32℃, mind sunscreen and hydration.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都晴朗，体感 31℃，紫外线强，出门记得防晒。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Sunny in Chengdu, feels like 31℃, strong UV, remember sunscreen when out.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉体感 34℃，闷热，注意防暑降温，多喝水！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan feels like 34℃, muggy, prevent heatstroke, stay cool, and drink more water!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安多云，湿度 78%，出门记得带好雨具，注意补水。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Xi'an with 78% humidity, remember your umbrella and stay hydrated.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆气温 33℃，体感炎热，注意防晒防暑，多喝水！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is 33℃ and feels hot, remember sun protection, heatstroke prevention, and drink water!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨湿度 96%，多云，别忘带雨具，注意防潮！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin has 96% humidity, cloudy, don't forget your umbrella and mind the dampness!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳阴天，体感 29℃，注意适时增减衣物，保持舒适。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Shenyang, feels like 29℃, adjust clothing as needed to stay comfortable.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明湿度 93%，气温 17℃，出门别忘带外套，注意保暖。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming has 93% humidity, 17℃, don't forget a jacket and stay warm when out.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门风力 5级，阴天，出门注意安全，小心高空坠物。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen has wind force 5 and is cloudy, be safe outdoors and watch for falling objects.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛雾气浓重，湿度 99%，出行请注意交通安全哦！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Dense fog in Qingdao with 99% humidity, please mind traffic safety when traveling!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连雾气浓，湿度高，出行请注意交通安全哦！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Heavy fog and high humidity in Dalian, please mind traffic safety when traveling!
